Download a newer catalog

Source: R/bundle.R
update_catalog.Rd

Downloads the bundle of an apb-catalog release from GitHub into the user cache, so lookups use it without a package update. Later sessions keep using the newest bundle, shipped or downloaded.

Usage

update_catalog(version = NULL)

Arguments

version

The apb-catalog release, such as "0.2.0"; NULL downloads the latest release.

Value

The catalog_version() now in use, invisibly.

Examples

if (interactive()) {
  update_catalog()
}
